results.note: Official fee page: adult (junior high school to age 64) park entry 1,600 yen; rides charged separately. One-day pass with unlimited rides is 4,600 yen. Page has no effective date.
Global Tourism Japan listing says admission is free. This is a third-party tourism directory, not an official site. Individual shops charge for their own goods and services.

Official ticket page: cheapest standard ticket is the timed-entry ticket at 2,350 yen. Price varies by date and runs up to 3,300 yen. The page gives this price for ages 3 and up and doesn't list a separate adult rate, so the adult price may differ by date. Buying by the day before the visit is cheaper.
Ministry of the Environment page lists admission to Kokyo Gaien (Imperial Palace Outer Gardens) as 無料 (free).
